name: botkins-hill-climber
description: Bots that get better with use. Quiet hooks record friction, and optional proactive retros turn it into small, logged improvements without waiting for someone to ask.

HILL_CLIMBER_NUDGES.title: Nudges
HILL_CLIMBER_NUDGES.description: on: after a correction (once per chat per 30 minutes) or when 5+ signals wait (once per bot per day), add a one-line hint for the bot. off: record signals only.

postInstallMessage: Signals stay on this computer. Hooks need the Copilot harness and Node.js. On Botkins 0.17.7+ the host owner can ask a bot to set up proactive Hill Climber retros once, so it wakes itself when a retro is due.
